svg.title: SwitchIt autonomous development graph
svg.desc: Proposed fanout orchestration: source and vendor investigators produce a vendor-neutral workflow package; isolated coders build source adapters, core workflows, target adapters and fixtures; independent verifiers test the integrated revision. Failed checks return only to their owners. Accepted work branches into skill, harness and platform packaging. A single release controller publishes only under an enabled standing release policy. Current publishing remains disabled.
svg.text: Investigate in parallel. Build independently. Verify before release.
1 coordinator / 3 active worker slots initially / more tasks queued
objective · source scope · budgets · release policy
task state · checkpoints · leases · dependency tracking
Single-writer merge · explicit gaps · immutable revisions · acceptance criteria fixed before coding
isolated patches → one candidate revision + build digest
fixed checks · comparable evidence · exact tested revision
coders cannot weaken checks to pass
final holdout · pinned artifact hashes · release rules
publish only when every required branch is accepted
skill · harness · platform / stop and recover on failure
Parallel workers · serial integration and publishing · no raw personal traces in releases
